Follow `AGENTS.md`. Start with `bash scripts/next-task.sh`; do only that task; run the task's Done checks and `npm run gate` before ticking the box.

Read `SPEC.md`, a phase preamble, or a skill only when the task names it or the file you touch triggers one (`components/ocean/**` → shader, colour/motion → a11y, `qa/REPORT.md` → QA gate). Never judge a screenshot — assert numbers in a Playwright spec. Never close a **U** item.
